question:
Rectify the sentence by selecting the correct spelling from the options.

The advertisement of vacencies in education sector has received huge response.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vacancies"** means unoccupied positions or jobs available for someone to fill. (रिक्तियां)

 
 
• **Example: **The company posted several job **vacancies** on their website.
 
 
 
• **"Vacancies"** is the correct spelling and usage in the given sentence. (रिक्तियां)
 
 
• **Example: **The advertisement of **vacancies** in the education sector has received a huge response.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Vacancies**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Vecencies** (वेकेंसीज़): This is an incorrect spelling and does not have a meaning.

 
 
• **Example:** N/A
 
 
 
• **Vecancies** (वेकैंसीज़): This is an incorrect spelling and does not have a meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** N/A
 
 
 
• **Vacansies** (वैकेंसीज़): This is an incorrect spelling and does not have a meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** N/A
